upstream-dependencies.title: Confirm upstream dependencies
upstream-dependencies.criterion: Record each dependency owner, confirmed delivery date, and any condition that could delay launch.

approvals-and-scope.title: Confirm launch scope and approvals
approvals-and-scope.criterion: Record the release audience and applicable decision owners, approvals, exclusions, and open risks.

enablement.title: Confirm customer and team enablement
enablement.criterion: Record the agreed communications, documentation, and support readiness for the launch audience.

rollout-and-rollback.title: Verify rollout and rollback readiness
rollout-and-rollback.criterion: Record the rollout owner, sequence, stop conditions, and confirmed rollback or containment procedure.

launch-monitoring.title: Verify launch monitoring
launch-monitoring.criterion: Confirm the dashboard, alert routing, and response owner with evidence from a readiness check.

support-handoff.title: Confirm support handoff and follow-through
support-handoff.criterion: Record receipt of the handoff, escalation owner, and resolution or ownership of remaining launch issues.

outcome-review.title: Review launch outcomes
outcome-review.criterion: Record the review date, measured results and guardrails, and ownership of any follow-up decision.
